limitations: Original synthetic native fixture bytes are generated in memory; there are no new third-party inputs or original database mutations.
ACE12-family code2 and ACE16 codes5/6 stored Int32 collections qualify actual list plumbing; these host tests do not establish native Access SQL or Text collation equivalence.
Named host query definition forwards native metadata/list callbacks; no saved-query writer or provider is implicitly activated.
No production source changes, public API changes, standalone CLI cargo build or original-getter CLI replay are counted here.
